name: computer_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the primary display.

name: computer_zoom
description: Return a region of the latest screenshot as a separate image at native resolution (up to 4×), so small or dense UI becomes legible. (x1, y1) is the top-left corner and (x2, y2) the bottom-right, inclusive; 20% padding is added; the region may be up to 914 canvas px on its long edge at any aspect, and one under 120×60 is widened to it. The result quotes a zoom_id and the image size: pass that zoom_id with x and y in zoom-image pixels to computer_click, computer_move, computer_scroll, or computer_drag. Actions still return a full-canvas screenshot, and a zoom_id describes the screen as it was when taken.

name: computer_click
parameters: {"type":"object","properties":{"x":{"type":"integer"},"y":{"type":"integer"},"button":{"type":"string","enum":["left","right","middle"],"description":"Mouse button. Defaults to left."},"count":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":3,"description":"Click count; 2 double-clicks. Defaults to 1."},"zoom_id":{"type":"string","description":"Id from a computer_zoom result: x and y are then pixels of that zoom image."}},"required":["x","y"]}

name: computer_move
description: Move the mouse cursor to a screen coordinate without clicking. Useful for revealing hover UI.
parameters: {"type":"object","properties":{"x":{"type":"integer"},"y":{"type":"integer"},"zoom_id":{"type":"string","description":"Id from a computer_zoom result: x and y are then pixels of that zoom image."}},"required":["x","y"]}

name: computer_drag
description: Press the mouse button at one coordinate, drag to another, and release. Or pass path (2–64 points) to drag through them in order in one call (a whole outline); a path of over two points must stay inside the window it starts in.
parameters: {"type":"object","properties":{"from":{"type":"object","properties":{"x":{"type":"integer"},"y":{"type":"integer"}}},"to":{"type":"object","properties":{"x":{"type":"integer"},"y":{"type":"integer"}}},"path":{"type":"array","minItems":2,"maxItems":64,"description":"{x, y} points, in order; replaces from and to."},"button":{"type":"string","enum":["left","right","middle"],"description":"Defaults to left."},"zoom_id":{"type":"string","description":"Id from a computer_zoom result: the points are then pixels of that zoom image."}}}

name: computer_type
description: Type text into the focused element using the keyboard. Click the target first so it has focus. A newline in the text presses Enter (it submits or navigates) and a tab presses Tab (next field or cell), so do not send a separate Return or Tab key press for them.

name: computer_key
description: Press a key or chord on the Windows keyboard, e.g. "Return", "Escape", "Tab", "ctrl+l", "win+r". Join modifiers with "+" (ctrl, alt, shift, win; cmd, super and meta also mean win). A modifier alone taps that key: "alt" taps Alt (Office KeyTips and the classic menu bar; follow with the tab letter, "alt h", or a second call); "shift" and "ctrl" tap those keys. Key names: space, backspace, delete (forward), insert, left, right, up, down, home, end, pageup, pagedown, f1–f12, apps (context menu), printscreen, capslock, numlock, scrolllock, pause, volumeup, volumedown, volumemute, mediaplaypause, medianext, mediaprev, mediastop, or any single character. Separate independent presses with a space ("win r" taps Win, then r).

name: computer_scroll
parameters: {"type":"object","properties":{"x":{"type":"integer"},"y":{"type":"integer"},"direction":{"type":"string","enum":["up","down","left","right"],"description":"Scroll direction. Defaults to down."},"amount":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":20,"description":"Scroll amount in wheel ticks. Defaults to 10."},"zoom_id":{"type":"string","description":"Id from a computer_zoom result: x and y are then pixels of that zoom image."}},"required":["x","y"]}

name: computer_wait
description: Wait for the screen to settle (page load, animation). Returns a screenshot only if the screen changed; otherwise text that your last one still stands. Prefer over repeated screenshots.
